world_news.headline: Australia news live: KPMG apologises to whistleblower as firm fronts inquiry over ethical failures
world_news.summary:
Parliamentary committee continues investigation into KPMG audit leaks. Follow today’s news live

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Good morning and welcome to our live news blog. I’m Martin Farrer with the top overnight stories and then it will be Nick Visser with the main action.

KPMG has reached out to apologise to the man who exposed its audit leaks scandal before an inquiry into its failures today, while Labor MPs want the government to do more to protect whistleblowers. More coming up.

world_news.headline: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
world_news.summary: Thousands of sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

world_news.headline: Sudan army says RSF advance on key town bordering Ethiopia
world_news.summary: Military and government sources say the paramilitary RSF and allies advance into town of Kurmuk in Blue Nile state.

world_news.headline: Passenger train derails, injuring several in southern England
world_news.summary: A passenger train derailed near Lewes in East Sussex, England,  injuring at least 11 people, and two of them seriously.

world_news.headline: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
world_news.summary: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.

world_news.headline: Long careers increase risk of brain damage, but is informed consent enough?
world_news.summary: As debate rages over Geelong defender Jake Kolodjashnij's controversial concussion waiver, what is the answer for players being exposed to potential brain damage in contact sports?

world_news.headline: Swans AFLW head coach looking to turn his young age to advantage
world_news.summary: With his playing days not far behind him, 30-year-old Colin O'Riordan feels like he can connect with the team at an emotional level.
